side_a.label: Blueberries are a universally loved treat

side_b.label: Many dogs want nothing to do with blueberries

tensions.why_it_matters: A blueberry supplement must appeal to owners whose dogs actively reject the whole fruit, making palatability and delivery format critical to product adoption.
tensions.suggested_question: Does your dog love or reject blueberries? Drop a 🫐 for love or 🙅 for nope — and tell us how you sneak superfoods into a picky pup's diet!

tensions.why_it_matters: Format and texture matter enormously for treat acceptance, suggesting a supplement or processed blueberry product could outperform raw whole berries for picky dogs.
